subject.title: refactor(macos): move PortGuardian state to SQLite

question: Should OpenClaw support the proposed one-way PortGuardian storage cutover, including fail-closed coexistence with older JSON-writing macOS app copies and no JSON-only downgrade path?
rationale: This changes the persistent-state and upgrade contract for host-global SSH tunnel recovery; source review cannot decide the supported downgrade and mixed-version policy on behalf of release owners.

options.title: Approve the SQLite-only cutover
options.body: Accept the documented one-way upgrade contract after final-head signed migration, mixed-copy, restart, and orphan-recovery proof is attached.

options.title: Require a different upgrade contract
options.body: Keep this PR open while maintainers define a supported migration or downgrade path before the JSON ledger is retired.

recommendation.title: Approve the SQLite-only cutover
recommendation.body: Accept the documented one-way upgrade contract after final-head signed migration, mixed-copy, restart, and orphan-recovery proof is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest identified owner of the merged adjacent native-state work and this PortGuardian migration design.
